newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Bunds pulled lower but seen outperforming.
newsitem.headline: German Bunds pulled lower but seen outperforming.

text.p: German Bunds and futures gave in to weakness on Friday, undermined by serious jitters in the French debt market and nervous U.S. Treasuries.
But traders said that despite the external downward pressure, Bunds are supported domestically by a steady interest rate environment, low inflation and sluggish growth.
"The Bunds are being hit by other international concerns," said one trader in London. "But if you look at the home front, they should be able to outperform, even on the way down.
By 1000 GMT, the June DTB Bund contract was trading 20 basis points lower at 100.40, off its early low of 100.32
